data.gender_notes: Alpert is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Alpheios, meaning 'protector' or 'noble one'. In Christian tradition, Alpert may be associated with St. Alpheus, a martyr in Syria. The name carries a strong sense of courage, kindness, and faithfulness. The name Alpert carries the meaning “Noble or kind protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alpert usually hope their child will grow to embody noble or kind protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אלפרט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלפרט הוא שם פרטי שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית, ומשמעותו 'איל אלוף' או 'אביר חזק וגדול'. השם אלפרט מורכב מ'אל' שפירושו 'איל' ומ'פרט' שפירושו 'אלוף' או 'חזק'. השם אלפרט נמצא בשימוש בקרב יהודים ואנשים נוצרים כאחד.

in_greek.name: Άλπερτ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Άλπερτ είναι ένα αρσενικό όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'αρσενικός, ισχυρός και λαμπρός'. Το όνομα Άλπερτ αποτελείται από το 'Al' που σημαίνει 'αρσενικός' και το 'bert' που σημαίνει 'ισχυρός' ή 'λαμπρός'. Το όνομα Άλπερτ ήταν δημοφιλές στην Ευρώπη κατά τον Μεσαίωνα.

in_latin.name: Alpert
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alpert est nomen masculinum quod originem habet in lingua germanica, et significat 'nobilis, fortis et magnus'. Nomen Alpert constat ex 'Al' quod significat 'nobilis' et 'pert' quod significat 'fortis' vel 'magnus'. Nomen Alpert in usu fuit apud christianos et judaeos.

in_english.name: Alpert
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alpert is of Germanic origin, meaning 'noble, strong and bright'. It is derived from the Old High German words 'adal' meaning 'noble' and 'bert' meaning 'bright' or 'strong'. The name Alpert has been used in Christian and Jewish communities, signifying strength, nobility, and illumination. Historically, the name Alpert was popular in Europe during the Middle Ages.

data.cultural_impact: Although the name Alpert is of Greek origin, it gained prominence in the Christian world primarily due to St. Alpheus, a 4th-century Syrian martyr. Timeless stories of his unwavering courage, obedience to faith, and missionary efforts have resonated through centuries and may have influenced how the name is perceived and valued within the Christian community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Alpert, meaning 'protector' or 'noble one', is deeply rooted in spiritual values. For those who bear the name, it is a constant reminder to be a source of strength and support for family, friends, and community. Additionally, the name's association with St. Alpheus adds a sacred and honorable dimension, inspiring those with the name to live lives of faith, courage, and dedication in the eyes of God.
